description: This file defines a PHP class Opencart\Catalog\Model\Cms\Antispam that extends a base Model class, and implements a method to check if a comment is spam based on a database query.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class for detecting spam comments within the Opencart CMS catalog module.

methods.name: getSpam
methods.description: Checks if a comment contains spam keywords by querying the database. Returns the count of matching spam keywords.
